expenses.home.search_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search box above the party list on the expenses home.

expenses.home.empty.value: No parties yet — add a person to start the ledger.
expenses.home.empty.description: Empty state of the expenses home when the business has no parties.

expenses.home.no_results.description: Shown when the party search filter returns nothing.

expenses.home.no_entries.description: Secondary line on a party row that has no ledger entries (instead of the last-entry relative time).

expenses.state.no_business.value: No business found for this account
expenses.state.no_business.description: Shown on the expenses section when the signed-in user has no business membership.

expenses.error.load_failed.value: Could not load data. Check your connection and try again.
expenses.error.load_failed.description: Generic load-failure message on the expenses screens.

expenses.error.save_failed.description: Generic save-failure message on the expenses forms.

expenses.person.name_label.description: Label of the party name field in the add-person dialog.

expenses.person.phone_label.description: Label of the optional phone field in the add-person dialog.

expenses.person.suggestions_title.description: Heading above the fuzzy-matched existing-party suggestions in the add-person dialog (duplicate steering).

expenses.person.name_required.description: Validation error when the party name is empty.

expenses.person.duplicate_exists.value: A party with this name already exists
expenses.person.duplicate_exists.description: Validation error when the typed party name exactly matches an existing party.

expenses.ledger.balance_chip.description: Balance-after chip on each ledger row. {amount} is a formatted rupee amount.

expenses.ledger.net_you_get.description: Net-balance caption when the party owes you (net positive).

expenses.ledger.net_you_give.description: Net-balance caption when you owe the party (net negative).

expenses.ledger.settled.description: Net-balance caption when the party balance is zero.

expenses.ledger.empty.value: No entries yet — record what you gave or got.
expenses.ledger.empty.description: Empty state of a person ledger with no entries.

expenses.ledger.back.description: Accessible label of the back button from a person ledger to the expenses home.

expenses.entry.edit_title.description: Dialog title when editing an existing ledger entry.

expenses.entry.attachments_label.description: Heading of the attachment list in the add/edit entry dialog.

expenses.entry.attach.description: Button that opens the file picker to attach an invoice (image/PDF) to an entry.

expenses.entry.attachment_pending.description: Badge on an attachment whose Google Drive upload has not completed yet.

expenses.entry.attachment_limit_hint.description: Hint under the attach button. {max} is the numeric attachment limit (4).

expenses.entry.amount_invalid.description: Validation error for an empty/invalid/non-positive amount.

expenses.entry.delete_title.description: Confirmation dialog title before tombstone-deleting a ledger entry.

expenses.entry.delete_message.value: The entry will be removed from the ledger.
expenses.entry.delete_message.description: Confirmation dialog body before tombstone-deleting a ledger entry.

inventory.stock.title.description: Title of the inventory current-stock list screen; also the toggle label back from the master list.

inventory.stock.search_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search box on the inventory screens.

inventory.stock.value_label.description: Label prefix for the FIFO total value shown on a stock row.

inventory.stock.updated.description: Last-transaction caption on a stock row. {time} is a localized relative time like '2 days ago'.

inventory.stock.empty.value: No stock yet — record a transaction to get started.
inventory.stock.empty.description: Empty state of the current-stock list when there are no items with stock.

inventory.stock.no_results.description: Shown when the item search filter returns nothing.

inventory.stock.record_transaction.description: FAB label and dialog title for recording an inventory add/remove transaction.

inventory.stock.open_masterlist.description: Top-bar toggle to the master-item management screen; also that screen's title.

inventory.state.no_business.value: No business found for this account
inventory.state.no_business.description: Shown on the inventory section when the signed-in user has no business membership.

inventory.error.load_failed.value: Could not load data. Check your connection and try again.
inventory.error.load_failed.description: Generic load-failure message on the inventory screens.

inventory.error.save_failed.description: Generic save-failure message on the inventory forms.

inventory.txn.remove.description: Transaction-type toggle: remove stock (consumes FIFO lots).

inventory.txn.no_matches.description: Shown in the item type-ahead when nothing matches the typed text.

inventory.txn.current_stock.description: Caption under the item picker showing the selected item's current stock. {qty} number, {unit} unit label.

inventory.txn.insufficient_stock.value: Cannot remove more than the current stock ({qty} {unit})
inventory.txn.insufficient_stock.description: Validation error when a remove quantity exceeds current stock.

inventory.txn.item_required.description: Validation error when no item is selected in the record-transaction dialog.

inventory.txn.quantity_invalid.description: Validation error for an empty/invalid/non-positive quantity.

inventory.txn.price_invalid.description: Validation error for an empty/invalid/negative unit price.

inventory.master.add_item.description: FAB label / dialog title for creating a master item.

inventory.master.edit_item.description: Dialog title when editing a master item.

inventory.master.name_label.description: Label of the master-item name field.

inventory.master.unit_label.description: Label of the unit dropdown on the master-item form.

inventory.master.unit_custom.description: Unit dropdown option that reveals a free-text custom unit field.

inventory.master.custom_unit_label.description: Label of the free-text field shown when the custom unit option is selected.

inventory.master.photo_label.description: Heading of the item photo section on the master-item form.

inventory.master.choose_photo.description: Button that opens the image picker on the master-item form (compressed to ≤320px WebP).

inventory.master.remove_photo.description: Button that clears the picked/existing photo on the master-item form.

inventory.master.similar_title.description: Heading above the fuzzy-duplicate suggestion chips on the master-item form (3+ chars, 40% similarity).

inventory.master.name_required.description: Validation error when the master-item name is empty.

inventory.master.duplicate_exists.value: An item with this name already exists

inventory.master.delete_title.description: Confirmation dialog title before tombstone-deleting a master item.

inventory.master.delete_message.value: The item will be removed from the master list.
inventory.master.delete_message.description: Confirmation dialog body before tombstone-deleting a master item.

inventory.master.delete_blocked.value: Cannot delete — this item has transactions
inventory.master.delete_blocked.description: Tooltip/message on a disabled delete button for a master item that has inventory transactions.

inventory.master.empty.value: No items yet — add your first item.
inventory.master.empty.description: Empty state of the master list.

inventory.master.image_upload_failed.description: Error shown when compressing/uploading the item photo to storage fails.
